title: DEGIRO Portfolio Position
description: Represents a single position in a DEGIRO trading account portfolio, including instrument reference, current holding size, and unrealised profit/loss.

id.description: DEGIRO product identifier for the instrument

positionType.description: Whether the position is a tradable instrument or a cash fund balance

price.description: Current market price of the instrument

value.description: Current market value of the position (size × price)

plBase.description: Base currency profit/loss figures keyed by currency code

todayPlBase.description: Today's profit/loss in base currency keyed by currency code

portfolioValueCorrection.description: Correction factor applied to the portfolio valuation for this position

breakEvenPrice.description: Average cost basis price at which the position breaks even
